name: When is it not worth trying a small paint touch-up myself?

mainEntity.name: When is it not worth trying a small paint touch-up myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: If the damage is in a high-visibility area, the paint is older than expected, or you only have a small amount of leftover paint, it is worth getting help instead of guessing. That is especially true when the wall has sheen, texture, or fading differences that can make a small repair obvious. A careful assessment can save time and prevent a patchy result.
acceptedAnswer.description: If the area is highly visible, the paint is old, or matching is uncertain, DIY often creates more work. In those cases, a professional assessment is usually the safer choice.
